scope: Full production ValidateShaders/Inspect on original synthetic shader inputs, the production ColorResolveFragment factory and canonical rectangle factory. No GPU, Wine game runtime or Solitaire gameplay result is claimed.
cause: Inspect did not register OpTypeImage, OpTypeSampler or OpTypeSampledImage. A direct UniformConstant image pointer required its pointee via Module::Type before the descriptor branch, causing the observed unknown-type rejection. The scan collects all type declarations before variable inspection; forward declaration order was not this failure.
change: Register opaque image/sampler/sampled-image types with instruction word-count checks.
Keep real type lookup and missing-type errors.
Validate concrete separate sampler/image kind and role against metadata.
Accept a bare single descriptor or one fixed array with exact metadata count. Nested/runtime arrays remain unsupported.
Compare declared image dimension/array/multisample form to recompiler imageShape; preserve numerical scalar types and sampled/storage classification.
Register OpTypeSampledImage for intermediate instructions; bound combined image/sampler globals remain unsupported because the runtime has separate descriptor kinds.

checks.independentSpirvValidation: Original fixtures target Vulkan1.1; factory and canonical rectangle modules target Vulkan1.2; all passed spirv-val.
positiveCases: Real production resolve fragment factories2/4/8 at bindings0/6 with actual production-generated canonical TCS/TES.
Separate image and sampler descriptors, both bare count1 and fixed arrays count1/count2.
negativeCases: Nonarray count and fixed array length/count mismatch.
Declared image dimension/array/multisample mismatch or absent imageShape metadata.

limits: Does not qualify production Driver→Graphics::Draw runtime or final Solitaire frames.
No GPU pipeline execution, image pixels, audio or FPS test in this evidence.
Malformed negative fixtures are tested for rejection; they are not presented as valid SPIR-V.
Private game shaders and image contents are unnecessary for reproduction and are not included.

primaryReference.supports: Opaque image, sampler and sampled-image type declarations and their operands.
